title: Crash in AudioStreamPlaybackMicrophone::stop() at program exit, AudioServer singleton is null
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable (official build), 4.6 [0227be0bdb184f58379d7b21889a1a961e91c079], 4.7 (current master) [bf95b62586e31b8a3503f5903d7764d7c52bf2ab]
- Not reproducible in: 4.5 and earlier

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.rc (0227be0bd) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 18 Jan 2026 00:34:07 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10850K CPU @ 3.60GHz (20 threads) - 62.67 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot crashes on exit in some circumstances on exit, in `AudioStreamPlaybackMicrophone` shutdown. The singleton returned by `AudioServer::get_singleton()` is null.

This happens rarely in a contrived test case, and with near-perfect consistency when running SnekStudio's current main branch ( https://github.com/ExpiredPopsicle/SnekStudio/ , commit `7b91b59a982d246ab181101ffb425c4dfc833771` )

### Steps to reproduce

Minimum reproduction (rare):
- Create a project.
- Create a 3D scene.
- Add an AudioStreamPlayer3D.
- Set the source to an AudioStreamMicrophone.
- Enable autoplay.
- Run the project.

SnekStudio reproduction (mostly-consistent):
- Check out SnekStudio, and follow the setup instructions.
- Start SnekStudio.
- Quit SnekStudio.

This also reproduces on SnekStudio's current nightly builds.
